series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a downward trend with weak strength and high seasonality variance. Concept drift is detected, and model rankings are unstable. A weighted combination approach with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to address the drift and unstable rankings while leveraging the high consensus among models.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance over time
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → use inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage to balance model performance differences
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
